Water Conservation and Restoration: Below are examples of water conservation projects Intel implemented
in 2023 as part of our commitment to achieve net positive water.
Our Penang site in Malaysia reclaims wastewater from our assembly
test manufacturing (ATM) operations via filtration and biocide control.
The reclaimed water is then recirculated in cooling towers, reducing
overall fresh water withdrawals. Following the success of this wastewater
reclaim strategy, this project was expanded in 2023 to achieve double
the water savings, or an additional 7 million gallons of water conserved
per year.
We continue identifying opportunities to segregate and recover rinse
water and bypass flows from our process manufacturing equipment.
By adding an additional treatment step to remove ozone, we have
significantly increased water reuse for factory systems such as cooling
towers, scrubbers, and abatement units. The first system was installed
in 2023 in our new F34 factory in Ireland, and is expected to conserve
approximately 200 million gallons of water per year when fully imple-
mented. Further retrofits to implement this project are planned in our
other factory sites in 2024.
